completeness_assessment.issue: All required metadata fields are present and documented across all 7 tables and 95 columns. No gaps identified.
completeness_assessment.recommendation: Continue maintaining comprehensive metadata documentation standards.

accuracy_assessment.issue: All data types in the semantic model (BIGINT, STRING, DATE, TIMESTAMP, DECIMAL, INT, BOOLEAN) accurately match the corresponding glossary types across all 95 columns.
accuracy_assessment.recommendation: Maintain strict type alignment in future updates.

accuracy_assessment.issue: All 7 documented relationships (orders_to_customers, order_items_to_orders, order_items_to_products, products_to_product_categories, product_categories_hierarchy, payments_to_orders, shipments_to_orders) correctly reference existing FK/PK columns with accurate many-to-one cardinalities.
accuracy_assessment.recommendation: Continue validating relationship cardinalities against constraint definitions.

accuracy_assessment.issue: The semantic model's ai_context provides detailed double-counting prevention guidance that accurately reflects the glossary's FK/PK structure and grain definitions.
accuracy_assessment.recommendation: Maintain alignment between technical constraints and analytical guidance.

efficiency_assessment.issue: The ai_context section contains 450+ lines of detailed guidance covering dataset grain, metric selection, join guidance, double-counting prevention, time analysis, hierarchical queries, and query restrictions. While comprehensive, some content is repetitive across sections.
efficiency_assessment.recommendation: Consider consolidating overlapping guidance sections and creating a reference structure to reduce redundancy while maintaining clarity.

efficiency_assessment.issue: Multiple metrics follow similar aggregation patterns (revenue_by_customer, revenue_by_product, revenue_by_category, revenue_by_sales_channel, revenue_by_customer_segment) that differ only in the grouping dimension. Each is defined as a separate complete metric with full SQL expressions.
efficiency_assessment.recommendation: Explore parameterized metric definitions or base metric references to reduce duplication and improve maintainability.

efficiency_assessment.issue: The recursive CTE pattern for product_categories hierarchy traversal is documented in the ai_context but not implemented as a reusable metric or view definition.
efficiency_assessment.recommendation: Consider creating a reusable hierarchy traversal metric or view that can be referenced by multiple downstream analyses.

efficiency_assessment.issue: Technical metadata fields (_source_system, _batch_id, _loaded_at) are documented individually for each of the 7 tables with nearly identical descriptions.
efficiency_assessment.recommendation: Create a shared metadata field glossary that can be referenced across tables to reduce repetitive documentation.
